# Agent Web Search

> Agent Web Search (PyPI: `agent-web-search-mcp`) is an open-source, MIT-licensed web search MCP server, CLI, and Python library for AI agents. It exposes one `web_search` tool that runs model-native search grounding providers and agent search APIs concurrently and returns one normalized JSON response. The default providers (DDGS, Exa, Parallel) need no API key.

Key facts:

- Interfaces: MCP server `agent-web-search-mcp` (stdio by default, stateless Streamable HTTP with `--transport http`), CLI `agent-web-search "<question>"`, and Python `agent_web_search.SearchEngine`. All share one tool schema and response shape.
- Tool arguments: `query` (natural-language question, 1-4,000 characters), optional `max_results` (1-20), `time_range` (`d`, `w`, `m`, `y`), `providers`, and `grok_search_mode` when Grok is enabled.
- Response: `providers.<name>.results[]` rows with `title`, `url`, `description`, optional `published_at` and `author`; model-backed providers may add `answer`. If every provider fails, the error code is `all_providers_failed`.
- Model-native grounding providers: `ark` (Volcengine Doubao), `gemini`, `grok`, `deepseek`, `zhipu_chat_search`, `responses` (any OpenAI Responses API gateway), `messages` (any Anthropic Messages API gateway), `codex_alpha` (experimental).
- Agent search providers: `exa`, `parallel`, `brave`, `perplexity`, `tavily`, `you`, `zhipu_web_search`. Conventional fallback: `ddgs` (DuckDuckGo).
- Configuration is environment-only (`AGENT_WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDERS`, provider API keys). Credentials are never tool arguments. No telemetry.
- Works with Codex CLI, Claude Code, OpenCode, Cursor, Cline, Claude Desktop, Hermes (native plugin), and any MCP client.
